SERVO_ATTACH_TOOLTIP: Attach a named servo instance to a pin (setup).
SERVO_READ_DEGREES_INPUT: the angle of the servo motor
SERVO_READ_DEGREES_TOOLTIP: returns the number of degrees the last rotation
SERVO_DETACH_TOOLTIP: Release a pin from servo driving.
SERVO_ATTACHED_TOOLTIP: true if the servo is attached to pin; false otherwise.
